name: Lovers
overview: The Scriptures highlight the deep affection and commitment demonstrated by several key biblical lovers. Isaac's love for Rebekah brought comfort after loss, as he took her into his mother’s tent and loved her (Genesis 24:67). Jacob’s enduring love for Rachel motivated him to serve fourteen years to marry her, showing love as a powerful motivating force (Genesis 29:20, 29:30). Similarly, Shechem’s soul clung to Dinah, expressing love through kindness and a willingness to provide a dowry in marriage (Genesis 34:3, 34:12). These instances reveal love as both a heartfelt devotion and a covenantal bond within God-ordained relationships.
